1.text: Amagambo y'Umubwiriza mwene Dawidi, umwami utuye i Yerusalemu.

2.text: Umubwiriza aravuga ati “Ubusa gusa! Nta kamaro! Byose ni ubusa!”

3.text: Ibyo umuntu agokera byose akiri mu isi bimumarira iki?

4.text: Abo ku ngoma imwe barashira hakaza abo ku yindi, ariko isi ihoraho iteka.

5.text: Izuba na ryo rirarasa rikarenga, rikihutira gusubira aho rirasira.

6.text: Umuyaga uhuha werekeye ikusi ugahindukirira ikasikazi uhora unyuranamo mu rugendo rwawo, kandi ugaruka kuzenguruka mu nzira zawo.

7.text: Inzuzi zose zisuka mu nyanja, nyamara inyanja ntiyuzura. Aho inzuzi zinyura ni ho zisubira kunyura.

8.text: Ibintu byose bifite umuruho mwinshi utavugwa: ijisho ntirihaga kurora, n'amatwi ntarambirwa kumva.

9.text: Ibyahozeho ni byo bizongera kubaho, kandi ibyakozwe ni byo bizongera gukorwa, nta cyadutse munsi y'ijuru.

10.text: Mbese hariho ikintu cyavugwa ngo “Dore iki ni inzaduka”? Na cyo cyahozeho kera mu bihe byariho mbere yacu.

11.text: Ibya mbere ntibicyibukwa, n'ibizaza hanyuma na byo abazakurikiraho ntibazabyibuka.

12.text: Jyewe Umubwiriza, nari umwami wa Isirayeli i Yerusalemu.

13.text: Nakomeje umutima wanjye gushaka no kugenzurisha ubwenge, kugira ngo menye iby'ibintu byose bikorerwa munsi y'ijuru, n'umuruho mubi Imana yahaye abantu ngo bawuruhe.

14.text: Nabonye imirimo yose ikorerwa munsi y'ijuru, kandi mbona byose ari ubusa, ni nko kwiruka inyuma y'umuyaga.

16.text: Nibwiye mu mutima wanjye ndavuga nti “Dore niyunguye ubwenge bwinshi kurusha abambanjirije i Yerusalemu bose. Ni ukuri umutima wanjye wabonye ubwenge bwinshi no kumenya.”

17.text: Nakomeje umutima wanjye kumenya ubwenge no kumenya iby'ubusazi n'ubupfapfa, menya yuko na byo ari nko kwiruka inyuma y'umuyaga,

18.text: kuko ubwenge bwinshi burimo agahinda kenshi, kandi uwunguka ubwenge yunguka n'umubabaro.
